description: A premier gathering of industry leaders, manufacturing executives, and experts dedicated to exploring innovative strategies, emerging trends, and best practices in manufacturing management. Brings together SVPs, VPs, and Directors of Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality, Lean/CI/OpEx Executives, and Plant Managers.
exhibitor_mix: Manufacturing technology providers, workforce management solutions, automation and robotics vendors, continuous improvement consultants, Industry 4.0 solution providers, maintenance and asset management software companies
audience_mix: SVPs, VPs, and Directors of Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality from companies like Toyota, Nestlé Purina, Intel, Estée Lauder, Tesla, 3M, Mattel, Boeing, and Ford. Over 400 attendees with 91% at Director level and above from 200+ global organizations
enrichment_notes: Event is a single-day summit focused on manufacturing excellence. Cost information not publicly available as this appears to be an invitation-based or executive-level event.

description: The premier exhibition in the U.S. dedicated to the full supply chain of the fastener industry, bringing together distributors, mechanical and design engineers, purchasers, wholesalers and OEMs. Serves sectors including automotive, aerospace, construction, HVAC, furniture, and appliances.
exhibitor_mix: Fastener manufacturers (screws, bolts, nuts, washers), raw materials and coatings suppliers (steel, aluminum, brass, titanium, stainless steel), fastening machinery and technology providers, industrial automation and robotics companies, surface treatment and plating technology vendors, assembly and installation systems providers
audience_mix: Distributors, mechanical and design engineers, purchasers, wholesalers, OEMs from automotive, aerospace, construction, HVAC, furniture, and appliance industries. 79% of attendees have final say or influence purchasing decisions, 82% consider the show important to attend
enrichment_notes: Event co-located with ALUMINUM Fabrication Summit. Attendee registration cost not specified on public website.

description: A premium, content-first pharmaceutical industry event specifically centered around the contract development and manufacturing (CDMO/CMO) ecosystem. Brings together the complete pharmaceutical supply chain with a focus on strategic partnerships and business development.
exhibitor_mix: Contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs/CMOs), API and excipient suppliers, pharmaceutical equipment and technology providers, biopharmaceutical companies, packaging and drug delivery innovators, analytical chemistry service providers, containment and isolation technology vendors
audience_mix: Pharmaceutical manufacturing executives, R&D leaders, procurement managers, supply chain directors, regulatory experts, quality professionals, business development executives from drug manufacturers, biotech companies, and pharmaceutical service providers. Expected 2,735+ attendees with decision-making authority
enrichment_notes: Reimagined format for 2026 with enhanced focus on contract manufacturing ecosystem. Formerly known as CPHI North America.

description: A groundbreaking new annual event for experts, decision-makers and solution providers along the chemical and bio-based production value chain. Highlights cutting-edge advancements in process engineering, biotechnology, and downstream processing, while bridging connections to the energy industry.
exhibitor_mix: Chemical engineering equipment providers, process automation and control systems vendors, biotechnology solution providers, pharmaceutical manufacturing technology companies, heat exchangers and separation systems manufacturers, pumps and valves suppliers, hydrogen and clean energy technology providers, laboratory equipment and analytics companies
audience_mix: Chemical engineers, CTOs, process and project engineers, plant managers, EPC firms, technology licensors, biopharma executives, CMOs, facility planners, regulatory professionals, QC leads from chemical, pharmaceutical, and energy industries
enrichment_notes: Brand new event launching in 2026 as a partnership between Gulf Energy Information and DECHEMA (organizers of ACHEMA). Will feature standalone U.S. events in 2026 and 2028.

cost: Registration varies by type - Premier Access includes BIO Partnering and ranges from member to non-member rates. Save up to $700 as BIO member
description: The world's largest biotechnology event bringing together leaders from biopharma, biotech, academia and investment. Features 130+ sessions in 18 focus areas including AI & digital health, cell and gene therapy, oncology, business development, and next-generation biotherapeutics. Includes proprietary BIO Partnering platform for structured business meetings.
exhibitor_mix: Biotechnology and biopharmaceutical companies, research institutions, contract research and manufacturing organizations (CROs/CDMOs), life sciences technology providers, diagnostic companies, investment firms, pharmaceutical service providers, laboratory equipment and reagent suppliers
audience_mix: Over 16,000 attendees from 65+ countries including C-suite executives, research directors, investors, regulatory professionals, scientists, business development leaders from pharmaceutical companies, biotech startups, academia, and government agencies. 1,600+ exhibitors representing innovative startups and global industry leaders
enrichment_notes: Largest global biotech event with extensive partnering component. 2025 edition (Boston) had 20,559+ companies from 73 countries with 57,044 partnering meetings. Company presentation fee: $2,000 members / $2,475 non-members.

description: A premier gathering of pharmaceutical industry leaders, manufacturing executives, and experts dedicated to exploring innovative strategies, emerging trends, and best practices in pharmaceutical management. Brings together senior executives focused on manufacturing excellence, quality, and supply chain optimization.
exhibitor_mix: Pharmaceutical manufacturing technology providers, quality management systems vendors, automation and digital transformation solutions, supply chain optimization platforms, technical operations consultants, maintenance and reliability technology companies, pharmaceutical equipment manufacturers
audience_mix: SVPs, VPs, and Directors of Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain from major pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical companies including Eli Lilly, Takeda, Bristol Myers Squibb, Halozyme, and other global pharma organizations. Approximately 200 attendees primarily at Director level and above, including Technology Leaders and Plant/Site/Facility Managers
enrichment_notes: Three-day summit with approximately 30 exhibitors and 52 speakers. Organized by Executive Platforms (same organizer as NAMES). Focused on pharmaceutical manufacturing operations and excellence.
